description.zh: 业务键，如场站名称编号。
description.en: Business key, such as a site name or ID.

description.zh:
本次调用的数据模式，枚举值：
- FULL：全量数据（仅使用本次调用中传递的数据）
- INCREMENTAL：增量数据（自动关联使用历史调用中相同BusinessKey的数据）
description.en:
Data mode for this invocation, enumeration values:  
- FULL: Full data (uses only the data passed in this invocation)  
- INCREMENTAL: Incremental data (automatically associates and uses data from previous invocations with the same BusinessKey)

description.zh:
设备类型，每个systemType支持的设备类型有：

系统类型：设备类型

- solar: solarInverter --光伏逆变器
- wind: windTurbine --风电发电机
description.en:
Device type. The supported device types for each systemType are:  

System Type: Device Type  

- solar: solarInverter -- Photovoltaic inverter  
- wind: windTurbine -- Wind turbine generator

description.zh:
从运行日(含)开始, 预测时长（单位：天）。

非必填，默认1天。
description.en:
Prediction duration in days, starting from and including the run date.  

Optional. Default value is 1 day.

description.zh:
预测时间尺度，枚举值：
- DAY_AHEAD：日前预测
- INTRADAY：日内预测
description.en:
Forecast time horizon, enumeration values:  
- DAY_AHEAD: Day-ahead forecast  
- INTRADAY: Intraday forecast

description.zh:
默认15min；需要与historyData的数据频率一致；枚举值：

- FIFTEEN_MIN: 15分钟
- FIVE_MIN: 5分钟
- ONE_HOUR: 1小时
- ONE_DAY: 1天
description.en:
Default is 15 min; must match the frequency of the historyData; enumeration values:  

- FIFTEEN_MIN: 15 minutes  
- FIVE_MIN: 5 minutes  
- ONE_HOUR: 1 hour  
- ONE_DAY: 1 day

description.zh: 历史负荷，需要90天的历史数据。
description.en: Historical load data. Requires 90 days of historical data.

description.zh: 每{freq}分钟，"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"， 数据频率需与freq字段对齐。
description.en: Every {freq} minutes, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss". The data frequency must snap to the freq field.
Location information, including latitude and longitude.

description.zh: 模型对应的版本号，默认为latest。
description.en: Version number of the model. Default is latest.
Run date, accurate to the day, in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.

description.zh:
系统类型，支持的系统类型有：

- solar: 光伏
- wind: 风电
description.en:
System type. Supported system types include:  

- solar: Photovoltaic  
- wind: Wind power
Time zone. The default is Asia/Shanghai (Shanghai time zone).
